warnings.message: npm: allowScripts takes package names only; "@scope/*" not written
warnings.fix: List the package names in installScripts.allow

warnings.message: Dependabot: default-days: 14 in .github/dependabot.yml (line 26) waits 2 weeks for github-actions updates, longer than cooldown.minimum "3d" in depcurfew.json; depcurfew apply replaces it with 3, so Dependabot waits only 3 days
warnings.fix: To keep the longer delay, set cooldown.minimum to "14d" in depcurfew.json and run depcurfew apply again
